chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan from Amr ibn Saeed from Musaddaq ibn Sadaqa from Ammar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The drowned one is withheld until his state changes and it is known that he has died, then he is washed and enshrouded.
He said: And he was asked about the one struck by lightning, so he said: If he is struck, he is withheld for two days, then he is washed and enshrouded.
ai.seo_question: What is the procedure for washing and enshrouping a person who drowned or was struck by lightning according to Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the jurisprudential distinction between drowning and lightning strikes regarding the timing of burial rites. While the drowned body is withheld until physical signs of death (such as decomposition) confirm it, the one struck by lightning is given a fixed two-day period, reflecting the Shia scholarly view that lightning strikes may not cause immediate death. This ruling ensures that the deceased is not buried prematurely while still alive, a critical concern in fiqh al-janazah.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan, from Amro Bin Saeed, from Musaddaq Bin Sadaqa, from Ammar, 
from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The drowned one would be withheld until his (state) changes, and it is known that he is dead. Then he would be washed and enshrouded’.
He (the narrator) said, ‘And he<sup>asws</sup> was asked about the one struck by lightning, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He would be withheld for two days, then he would be washed and enshrouded’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn al-Hassan from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
One who has died because of drowning is kept until there is a change and his death becomes certain; then his Ghusl (bath) and shroud are done.’

He (the narrator) has said that he (the Imam) was asked about one who has died because of a sudden shock. He (the Imam) said, ‘If it (death) is because of sudden shock, he is kept for two days, then his Ghusl (bath) and shroud are done.’”
